```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_scores_raw
title: >
  Describe the Scores
questions:
  - id: raw_scores
    type: free-response
    checkLabel: Compare your answer
    prompt: >
      You completed one test in 8 seconds and another in 70 seconds. Would you
      describe your performances as good, bad, or just okay? Why, or why not?
    hint: >
      What else would you want to know before comparing your performances
      relative to other people?
    answer: >
      You might have a sense of how you did from trying the questions yourself.
      But the times alone don't tell us whether either performance was good
      compared with other people's. Eight seconds might be impressively quick
      on one test and nothing special on another.
```
